narrative.subMessage: TC+NCF is less sensitive to warpage; MR+MUF favors productivity and thermal resistance.
narrative.headline: HBM Package Technologies
narrative.summary: The two methods use different bonding flows. The source pros and cons are shown side by side.
narrative.story: TC+NCF is less sensitive to thin-die warpage, but bonding each die lowers productivity and raises thermal resistance. MR+MUF offers high productivity and low thermal resistivity, but is more sensitive to chip warpage and narrow gap fill.
keyTakeaways: TC+NCF: less sensitive to thin-die warpage
MR+MUF: high productivity and low thermal resistivity
MR+MUF challenges: chip warpage sensitivity and narrow gap fill
narrative.viewerAction: Compare the two methods row by row across process, pros, and cons.
